free_tier.stated: No free tier. VPS NAT LXC 1gb ram is Rp10.000,00 a month for 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 512 MB swap, 10 GB SSD, LXC, shared IPv4 with 4 forwarded ports, unlimited bandwidth at 300 Mbps, in Beauharnois, Canada.

retention.stated: the container persists for the paid month; the store prints no deletion schedule and no refund term

egress.terms: 'Unlimited Bandwidth (300 Mbps)' on the plan body, i.e. a port cap rather than a byte allowance; no overage price is printed because there is no meter

interface_detail: LXC container with root; the store prints no control panel, and Docker is explicitly unsupported on this plan
tooling: any SSH client; the vendor provisions in 10-30 minutes ('Setup 10-30 menit') rather than instantly
chaining: the best shape per dollar: 1 GB of RAM, 10 GB of disk and unmetered 300 Mbps for USD 0.5541 a month, at the cost of only 4 forwarded ports

limits.value: shared IPv4 with 4 forwarded ports; a dedicated IPv4 is sold as an option at Rp50.000,00

binding_note: 4 forwarded ports is the smallest port block and the first thing that fails: a WireGuard listener, SSH and one web port already use three of the four.

identity_cost.detail: no card hold and no payment method is printed on the product page or the checkout page read; checkout is a Laravel/Livewire cart that requires an account, and the rails are unverified

reliability_note: no reliability event observed; the vendor states a 10-30 minute manual setup rather than instant provisioning
confidence_note: price, billing period, shape, port count and location are quoted from the vendor's own product and checkout pages read; the price is in IDR and converted at a dated rate; the port assignment rule, UDP support, the SSH port rule and the payment rails are unpublished

evidence.proved: quoted plan body: '1vCPU / 1GB RAM / 512MB SWAP RAM / 10GB SSD DISK / LXC Virtualization / IPV4 Shared(Dedicated IPV4 Available) / 4 Port Forwarding / Unlimited Bandwidth (300 Mbps) / Docker is not supported / North America (Canada - East - Beauharnois) / Setup 10-30 menit' at 'Rp10.000,00'

quoted billing-period selector: '<option value="53">Monthly - Rp10.000,00</option>', alongside 'Custom - month recurring - Rp6.499,00' and 'Custom - month recurring - Rp7.000,00'; and the dedicated-IPv4 option renders '1x - Rp50.000,00'

notes: The strongest shape under the line: 1 GB of RAM, 512 MB of swap, 10 GB of SSD and unmetered traffic at 300 Mbps for IDR 10,000, which is USD 0.5541 a month at the CBR rate dated 24.10.2026. The caveat is the port block. Four forwarded ports is the smallest found anywhere, and the vendor sells a dedicated IPv4 as a paid option at IDR 50,000, which is USD 2.77 a month and would take the plan over the line. The checkout selector also lists two cheaper 'Custom - month recurring' plans on the same product at IDR 6,499 (USD 0.3602) and IDR 7,000 (USD 0.3879); their shapes were not read, so they are recorded here as a lead rather than a price. Not established: whether the 4 ports are assigned by the host or chosen by the buyer, whether SSH is one of the 4 or additional, whether UDP is forwarded, and the payment methods.

extras.term: monthly ('Monthly - Rp10.000,00' in the checkout plan selector)
extras.price_arithmetic: IDR 10,000 a month x (44.6269 RUB per IDR 10,000 / 80.5381 RUB per USD) = USD 0.5541 a month. Both rates from the CBR table dated 24.10.2026. A VPS bills whether it runs or not, so the 24/7 and 10 h/day figures are the same. Cheaper sibling plans on the same product: IDR 6,499 = USD 0.3602/mo and IDR 7,000 = USD 0.3879/mo, shapes unread.
extras.renewal_note: the checkout selector prints 'Monthly' as the period with no strike-through and no promo code, so IDR 10,000 is the ordinary rate; no renewal cycle is stated separately

network_out.ports: shared IPv4 with 4 forwarded ports; a dedicated IPv4 is an option at IDR 50,000

extras.payment_methods: not stated on the product or checkout page
extras.stock: in stock: the product page renders a live price and an 'Add to cart' / checkout link, and no out-of-stock marker appears on 2026-10-24

session_cap.note: none; it is a container that persists for the paid month
